title: Pencil cup
about: A round cup for pens and pencils: a cylinder shelled to 2.5 mm walls with its top open, and its bottom edge bevelled so it doesn't snag. The bevel goes on after the shell, on the outside only.
picture_alt: A round open cup with thin walls and a bevelled bottom edge
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=CupSketch kind=radius on=Circle1 value=35 name=Radius

change.about: make it 80 mm across instead of 70 mm (CupSketch's Radius): the walls stay 2.5 mm, and the bevel follows the bottom edge.
